correctness.rationale: Independent exact census: construct the 11 neighbors lists for mu(C5), add the incumbent as an extra voter exactly at even-degree vertices (equivalent to tie retention), and evaluate strict odd-input majority simultaneously on all 2048 bitmasks. Seed the recurrent set by F(F(x))=x. Grow its inverse images one full breadth layer at a time, inheriting the least mask of the target orbit; since this exhausts every state by layer 7, no longer cycle can exist. The fixed/oscillating entry pairs for t=0,...,7 are (22,70),(262,130),(594,10),(290,0),(280,0),(230,0),(130,0),(30,0). The 30 last-layer masks lead only to unanimity. For example 107 -> 663 -> 363 -> 1687 -> 1003 -> 1695 -> 1023 -> 2047, then fixed. Basin counting gives the seven stated rows, including two unanimous basins of 884 (221/256 of all starting states). All twenty dihedral/complement maps commute with the full computed map and canonicalizing both phases under them gives precisely one symmetry class per basin row. This verifies the sharp identities and complete labelled/symmetry census without presupposing the clock or a period bound.
residual_risks: The reproducible proof is for the single labelled graph and stated synchronous rule, not other graphs or tie rules.

checked_sources: Independent complete census and symmetry reduction in reproductions/majority.py
value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the canonical pentagon Mycielski lift, a small triangle-free four-chromatic test graph. The general period constraint says nothing about the likelihood of unanimity, the exceptional attraction of nontrivial fixed points and oscillations, or the exact maximal transient. The seven-row labelled and symmetry classification gives these quantitative baselines for the standard deterministic process: unanimity dominates, and all sharp-depth trajectories reach it, despite 55 other recurrent orbits. This is useful as an exact benchmark on a motivated, structurally asymmetric graph, not a claim of a general convergence theorem.
residual_risks: Finite canonical example only; no extrapolation to the full Mycielski family or nonuniform initial measures is justified.
